question: Who among the following was part of the gold medal winning Indian hockey team of 1928 Summer Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amrit Mohan Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Amrit Mohan Prasad** was appointed as the **Director General of the Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB)** in **September 2024**, succeeding the previous DG of the paramilitary force.

• The **Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB)** is one of India's Central Armed Police Forces responsible for guarding the **India-Nepal and India-Bhutan borders**.

• **Amrit Mohan Prasad** is a senior officer with extensive experience in border security and internal security operations. His leadership is expected to enhance the operational efficiency of the SSB.

• The appointment of the Director General is made by the Government of India based on the officer's merit, experience, and capability to lead a paramilitary force effectively.

• The SSB plays a vital role in ensuring national security, preventing trans-border crimes, and maintaining peace and tranquility along India's borders with Nepal and Bhutan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB):**

• The SSB was established in **1963** after the Sino-Indian War to strengthen India's border security.

• It is tasked with ensuring the security of the **India-Nepal** and **India-Bhutan borders**, covering an area of approximately **1,751 km** and **699 km**, respectively.

• The force also assists in providing **disaster management**, conducting **civic action programs**, and supporting the local population in border areas.

• **Role of Director General in SSB:**

• The Director General oversees the overall functioning, strategy formulation, and operational planning of the force.

• He ensures that the force is equipped and trained to handle challenges such as cross-border infiltration, smuggling, and maintaining border peace.

• **Other Key Appointments in Border Security Forces:**

• India's border security forces include the **Border Security Force (BSF)**, **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)**, and **Assam Rifles**, each led by their respective Director Generals.

• Appointments to these roles are typically made from the **Indian Police Service (IPS)** or other senior paramilitary officers.

• **Importance of Border Security:**

• India shares borders with seven neighboring countries, making border security a vital aspect of national security.

• Forces like the SSB play a crucial role in preventing **illegal immigration**, **smuggling**, and **infiltration** while fostering friendly relations with neighboring countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Organizational Structure of SSB:**

• The SSB functions under the administrative control of the **Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India**.

• It comprises various battalions and formations deployed along the borders and in other parts of the country.

• **Recent Initiatives by SSB:**

• Implementation of advanced surveillance technology and drones for better border monitoring.

• Collaboration with local communities to enhance intelligence gathering and ensure border area development.
